pk/math.text: Demonstrates number sense and an understanding of quantity
Explores combining and separating groups (numerical operations)
Participates in exploratory measurement activities and compares objects
Explores and describes shapes and spatial relationships

pk/language.text: Understands and responds to language (in child’s home language)
Uses increasingly complex vocabulary, grammar, and sentence structure (in child’s home language)
Communicates using social and conversational rules
Demonstrates progress in attending to, understanding, and responding to English
Demonstrates progress in speaking and expressing self in English
Engages in read-alouds and conversations about books and stories
Notices and manipulates the sounds of language
Responds to features of books and print
Shows knowledge of the shapes, names, and sounds of letters

pk/science.text: Engages in the scientific process to collect, analyze, and communicate information
Demonstrates knowledge of core science ideas and concepts
Demonstrates knowledge of the characteristics of living things, the earth’s environment, and physical objects and materials
Uses tools and engineering practices to explore and solve problems
Engages in developmentally appropriate interactions with technology and media that support creativity, exploration, and play

pk/social.text: Forms trusting relationships with nurturing adults
Experiences, expresses, and regulates a range of emotions
Interprets and responds to the feelings of others
Shows awareness of self as unique individual
Demonstrates positive connection to family and community
Shows awareness of sequence and change over time
